extracted.name: Creamy Waldorf Salad
extracted.description: This creamy Waldorf salad with apples, grapes, celery and nuts is super easy to make ahead and chill for a refreshing summer side dish.
instruction_lines: Toss apples and lemon juice together in a large bowl; stir in celery, nuts, raisins and grapes.
Fold whipped cream and mayonnaise together; add to salad and mix well.
Sprinkle with nutmeg and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.
